_doc: Persistent supervisor state for the Work-PC autonomous QA node. Survives Claude process crashes, supervisor crashes, and Windows restarts - a fresh Fable QA Director invocation reads this FIRST to decide what to do, with zero dependence on conversational memory. NEVER contains secrets, tokens, cookies, storageState, or credentials.
next_action: FOUNDER GATE: start the node once. Either install auto-start (powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File qa/runner/install-autostart.ps1) or run node qa/runner/supervisor.mjs in a terminal. This session is not permitted to launch an unattended bypass-permissions agent itself. Until then the interactive session continues C002 manually.

resource_governor._doc: Operational safeguards. These bound cost/load; they must NEVER silently reduce coverage. If a limit pauses QA the status is PAUSED_RESOURCE_LIMIT and remaining work stays QUEUED - never reported as VERIFIED.
resource_governor._max_concurrent_note: Starting conservative at 3 (not the charter's 4-8 ceiling) and benchmarking first, per the charter's own explicit benchmark-before-scaling instruction. Every worker hits the SAME production DB as the same founder identity - there is no per-tenant isolation beyond company_id/RLS - so fixture-namespace discipline is the only thing preventing cross-worker contamination. Scale up only after 2-3 workers prove clean.

authentication._doc: No secrets stored here. Records only WHICH mechanism is in use so a recovering session knows what to check.
authentication.claude_code_auth: inherited from the machine's existing Claude Code login
authentication.supabase_cli_auth: persisted OS-level credential (already logged in; project pvphxgrtdfrudejjhzjk linked)
authentication.vercel_cli_auth: persisted OS-level credential (authenticated 2026-08-31 for deployment provenance)
authentication.browser_session: founder session already authenticated in the Playwright-controlled browser; storageState is exported to a LOCAL, GIT-IGNORED path only - never committed, never logged
